questions: What is the initial concentration Es(0) of the complex E* in a.u.?
limitations: The source calls the complex E* in prose and Es in its equations; experiment.json requests Es.

Es(0) is explicitly unreported. E(0) and S(0) specify free species concentrations and do not determine Es(0); a closed system does not imply an initially absent complex. No trajectory can be determined at the 41 requested sampling times without this initial condition.
